attributes.action: Review and strengthen heatwave guidance for schools in England
attributes.additional_details: Many schools in England were not designed for prolonged periods of extreme heat and lack air conditioning. During heatwaves, classroom temperatures can become unsafe for pupils and staff, affecting health, wellbeing, concentration and learning. We want the Government to introduce clear national temperature thresholds and guidance, including when schools should consider remote learning or temporary closure if classrooms become excessively hot.
attributes.background: We want the Government to review and strengthen heatwave guidance for schools in England by introducing clear classroom temperature limits. Where temperatures become unsafe and cannot be reduced through cooling measures, schools should move to remote learning or temporarily close.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

Legislate a statutory maximum temperature for classrooms and fund school cooling
